message.content: Calculating annual revenue, cost, and margin by fiscal year — joining sales to dates and aggregating.

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT
  d."Fiscal Year" AS "Fiscal Year",
  SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS total_revenue,
  SUM(s."Total Product Cost") AS total_cost,
  SUM(s."Sales Amount") - SUM(s."Total Product Cost") AS gross_profit,
  CASE WHEN SUM(s."Sales Amount") <> 0 THEN (SUM(s."Sales Amount") - SUM(s."Total Product Cost")) / SUM(s."Sales Amount") * 100 ELSE NULL END AS gross_margin_pct,
  COUNT(*) AS total_order_lines
FROM "Sales" s
JOIN "Date" d ON s."OrderDateKey" = d."DateKey"
GROUP BY d."Fiscal Year"
ORDER BY d."Fiscal Year" ASC"}

message.content: Comparing Reseller vs Internet channels — building your revenue, share, and margin breakdown.

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT
    so."Channel" AS "Channel",
    SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS "total_revenue",
    SUM(s."Sales Amount") / SUM(SUM(s."Sales Amount")) OVER () * 100 AS "revenue_share_pct",
    COUNT(DISTINCT so."Sales Order") AS "total_orders",
    COUNT(*) AS "order_lines",
    AVG(s."Sales Amount") AS "avg_line_amount",
    (SUM(s."Sales Amount") - SUM(s."Total Product Cost")) / SUM(s."Sales Amount") * 100 AS "gross_margin_pct"
FROM "Sales" s
JOIN "Sales_Order" so ON s."SalesOrderLineKey" = so."SalesOrderLineKey"
GROUP BY so."Channel"
ORDER BY "total_revenue" DESC;"}

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p."Category" AS "Category",
        SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS "revenue",
        SUM(s."Order Quantity") AS "units_sold",
        SUM(s."Sales Amount" - s."Total Product Cost") AS "gross_profit"
    FROM "Sales" s
    JOIN "Product" p ON s."ProductKey" = p."ProductKey"
    GROUP BY p."Category"
)
SELECT
    "Category",
    "revenue",
    "revenue" / SUM("revenue") OVER () * 100 AS "revenue_share_pct",
    "units_sold",
    "gross_profit",
    "gross_profit" / "revenue" * 100 AS "gross_margin_pct"
FROM category_sales
ORDER BY "revenue" DESC"}

{"sql":"WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p."Category" AS "Category",
        SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS "revenue",
        SUM(s."Order Quantity") AS "units_sold",
        SUM(s."Sales Amount" - s."Total Product Cost") AS "gross_profit"
    FROM "Sales" s
    JOIN "Product" p ON s."ProductKey" = p."ProductKey"
    GROUP BY p."Category"
)
SELECT
    "Category",
    "revenue",
    "revenue" / SUM("revenue") OVER () * 100 AS "revenue_share_pct",
    "units_sold",
    "gross_profit",
    "gross_profit" / "revenue" * 100 AS "gross_margin_pct"
FROM category_sales
ORDER BY "revenue" DESC"}

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p."Category" AS "Category",
        SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS "revenue",
        SUM(s."Order Quantity") AS "units_sold",
        SUM(s."Sales Amount" - s."Total Product Cost") AS "gross_profit"
    FROM "Sales" s
    JOIN "Product" p ON s."ProductKey" = p."ProductKey"
    GROUP BY p."Category"
)
SELECT
    "Category",
    "revenue",
    "revenue" / SUM("revenue") OVER () * 100 AS "revenue_share_pct",
    "units_sold",
    "gross_profit",
    "gross_profit" / "revenue" * 100 AS "gross_margin_pct"
FROM category_sales
ORDER BY "revenue" DESC"}

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH avg_list AS (
    SELECT "Subcategory", AVG("List Price") AS avg_list_price
    FROM "Product"
    GROUP BY "Subcategory"
)
SELECT
    p."Subcategory" AS "Subcategory",
    COUNT(s."SalesOrderLineKey") AS order_lines,
    SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS revenue,
    SUM(s."Order Quantity") AS units_sold,
    SUM(s."Sales Amount") / NULLIF(SUM(s."Order Quantity"), 0) AS revenue_per_unit,
    a.avg_list_price AS avg_list_price,
    SUM(s."Sales Amount") - SUM(s."Total Product Cost") AS gross_profit,
    (SUM(s."Sales Amount") - SUM(s."Total Product Cost")) / NULLIF(SUM(s."Sales Amount"), 0) * 100 AS margin_pct
FROM "Sales" s

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH subcategory_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p."Category" AS "Category",
        p."Subcategory" AS "Subcategory",
        SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS revenue,
        SUM(s."Order Quantity") AS units_sold,
        SUM(s."Sales Amount" - s."Total Product Cost") AS gross_profit
    FROM "Sales" s
    JOIN "Product" p ON s."ProductKey" = p."ProductKey"
    GROUP BY p."Category", p."Subcategory"
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        "Category",
        "Subcategory",
        revenue,
        units_sold,
        gross_profit,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "Category" ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY "Category") AS category_revenue
    FROM subcategory_revenue
)
SELECT
    "Category",
    revenue_rank,
    "Subcategory",
    revenue,
    units_sold,
    gross_profit,
    (revenue / category_revenue * 100) AS category_revenue_share_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank <= 2
ORDER BY "Category" ASC, revenue_rank ASC, "Subcategory" ASC"}

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql":"WITH subcategory_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p."Category" AS "Category",
        p."Subcategory" AS "Subcategory",
        SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS revenue,
        SUM(s."Order Quantity") AS units_sold,
        SUM(s."Sales Amount" - s."Total Product Cost") AS gross_profit
    FROM "Sales" s
    JOIN "Product" p ON s."ProductKey" = p."ProductKey"
    GROUP BY p."Category", p."Subcategory"
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        "Category",
        "Subcategory",
        revenue,
        units_sold,
        gross_profit,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "Category" ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY "Category") AS category_revenue
    FROM subcategory_revenue
)
SELECT
    "Category",
    revenue_rank,
    "Subcategory",
    revenue,
    units_sold,
    gross_profit,
    (revenue / category_revenue * 100) AS category_revenue_share_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank <= 2
ORDER BY "Category" ASC, revenue_rank ASC, "Subcategory" ASC"}

questionText: For each territory group and fiscal year, show the top sales channel by revenue, along with that channel's revenue, the total revenue for the group-year, and the channel's share of the group-year revenue. Return columns: Group, Fiscal Year, top_channel, channel_revenue, group_year_revenue, channel_revenue_share_pct. Sort by Group, then Fiscal Year ascending.
questionLabel: [Q25][hard] For each territory group and fiscal year, show the top sales channel by revenue, along with that channel's revenue, the total revenue for the group-year, and the channel's share of the group-year revenue. Return columns: Group, Fiscal Year, top_channel, channel_revenue, group_year_revenue, channel_revenue_share_pct. Sort by Group, then Fiscal Year ascending.

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT st.\"Group\" AS grp, d.\"Fiscal Year\" AS fy, so.\"Channel\" AS ch, SUM(s.\"Sales Amount\") AS rev, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM \"Sales\" s JOIN \"Sales_Order\" so ON s.\"SalesOrderLineKey\" = so.\"SalesOrderLineKey\" JOIN \"Date\" d ON s.\"OrderDateKey\" = d.\"DateKey\" JOIN \"Sales_Territory\" st ON s.\"SalesTerritoryKey\" = st.\"SalesTerritoryKey\" GROUP BY st.\"Group\", d.\"Fiscal Year\", so.\"Channel\" ORDER BY st.\"Group\", d.\"Fiscal Year\", rev DESC LIMIT 20"}
